feat(infra): deploy-phase3-opensanctions.sh — Yente stub (ADR-009)

5-step deployment stub for OpenSanctions/Yente on GMKtec:
  [1/5] docker + docker compose check
  [2/5] /opt/banxe/opensanctions/ + docker-compose.yml (port 8086),
        manifest.yml (default catalog + wikidata PEP + local TODO),
        .env.example
  [3/5] image pull + docker compose up -d
  [4/5] health check with retry (6×20s; warns on slow initial index)
  [5/5] next steps: test match query, sanctions_check.py routing,
        registry binding, reindex command, production hardening TODO

Watchman :8084 remains active as fallback per ADR-009.
--dry-run flag supported.
